name: Blob Tracking
vibe: Computer-vision motion detection — soft amorphous blobs of color drift over a dark feed, tagged with bounding boxes and confidence labels like `person 0.97`.
best_for: Creator Studio and campaign overviews — content clusters as detectable “blobs” moving through the feed.
signature: Corner tracking brackets + drifting blob washes + mono confidence labels — the feed is always watching, always labeling.
motion: Organic and fluid: 250-400ms ease-in-out; blobs drift on 8-20s loops; entries soften in (opacity + blur 4px→0). Nothing moves linearly — everything eases like matter.
texture_style: background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(92, 255, 176, 0.08), transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%, rgba(92, 200, 255, 0.08), transparent 50%);

schemas.name: Heatmap
schemas.desc: Jet-heatmap accents with electric blue secondary; use white bold labels on hot fills.

schemas.name: Thermal Cyan
schemas.desc: Cool cyan tracks with violet secondary; use dark ink labels on cyan.

doc:
### PROPOSAL-22 — Blob Tracking - **slug**: `blob-tracking` - **Vibe**: Computer-vision motion detection — soft amorphous blobs of color drift over a dark feed, tagged with bounding boxes and confidence labels like `person 0.97`. - **Best for**: Creator Studio and campaign overviews — content clusters as detectable "blobs" moving through the feed. Adjectives: organic, analytical, fluid. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#050807` | Camera-feed black-green | | `--bg-surface` | `#0d1512` | Feed panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#152220` | Tracked-region highlight fill | | `--border-subtle` | `#1e332c` | Faint grid hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#2e4f42` | Detection-box borders | | `--border-focus` | `#5cffb0` | Tracker-lock focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#eafff4` | Bright label text | | `--text-secondary` | `#b2d8c6` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#6a9482` | Feed-noise dim text | | `--color-action` | `#5cffb0` | Tracker-green primary | | `--color-action-hover` | `#3fe596` | Action hover (deeper green) | | `--color-earnings` | `#ffe45c` | High-confidence yellow tag | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#e6c93f` | Earnings hover (deeper yellow) | | `--color-automation` | `#5cc8ff` | Secondary-track cyan | | `--color-alert` | `#ffb54a` | Motion-detected amber | | `--color-danger` | `#ff5c7a` | Track-lost red | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(92, 255, 176, 0.18)` | Tracker bloom | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(255, 228, 92, 0.16)` | Tag bloom | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(92, 200, 255, 0.16)` | Cyan bloom | - **Typography**: CV-overlay labeling. Display: `"Space Grotesk", sans-serif` at 600. Body: `"Inter", system-ui, sans-serif`. Mono: `"JetBrains Mono", monospace` for confidence scores and IDs — every blob gets a label like `earnings_blob 0.97`. Uppercase micro-labels on boxes. KPIs `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Detection-box language: 2px radius on chips and boxes, cards `rounded-lg`. Borders 1px; tracked items get corner brackets (like camera focus brackets) instead of full outlines. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Soft rounded fills with a 1px border; primary = tracker-green with dark text. Hover = corner brackets appear around the button (tracking acquired). Focus = 2px outline. - **Cards**: Panels with soft blob-wash backgrounds (large radial gradients of action/automation glow at 6-10% opacity drifting slowly via CSS animation). Active cards get corner brackets + a mono confidence label. - **Badges/Status**: Tag chips like CV labels: `PUBLISHED 0.98`, `FAILED 0.02`, `RUNNING …` — colored border, dark fill, mono confidence. Dot pulses when a track is live. - **Tables**: Rows are "tracks": hover locks the row (corner brackets + brighter fill); a small mono trail of dots (motion trail) follows the hover across columns. - **Forms/Inputs**: Rounded fields, 1px borders; focus = tracker-lock border + brackets. Placeholder text dimmed like feed noise. - **Loading**: Blobs wander: 2-3 soft radial-gradient shapes drift and morph (border-radius animation) until content arrives; determinate = blob shrinking onto its target box. - **Signature detail**: Corner tracking brackets + drifting blob washes + mono confidence labels — the feed is always watching, always labeling. - **Motion & Animation**: Organic and fluid: 250-400ms ease-in-out; blobs drift on 8-20s loops; entries soften in (opacity + blur 4px -> 0). Nothing moves linearly — everything eases like matter. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
EARNINGS_BLOB 0.97 $12,480.50
```
